checkpoint: Vue child-slot lifetime and native edits, based on 3a347b4e
implementation: Own and borrowed outlets share logical child-slot frames. Repeated ordinary outlets use the same lifetime owner. Vue owns the retained child VNodes, component scopes, patching and final disposal.

The adapter extends Vue Teleport renderer hooks to retain children across destination removal and delegate normal SSR hydration and marker creation. It uses native fragments/live sibling ranges and the existing shared document mutation hub.
Only explicit as lists enroll accepted children. Scoped-only repeated slots retain native Vue outlets without plain-projection helpers.
Literal native control values use attribute writes, preserving dirty pre-hydration state. Same-destination reactive updates avoid native moves and preserve typing focus.

Source slot function replacements notify retained views. Empty text remains assigned content. Fragment filtering normalizes nested render-function text once, and disposed accepted roots get fresh mount VNodes when their outlet reopens.
A pure ChildSlot factory allows bundlers to remove unused projection machinery from unrelated components.
